records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The accompanying unaudited, consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States ("GAAP") for interim financial information and with the instructions to Form 10-Q and Rule 10-01 of Regulation S-X. These unaudited, consolidated financial statements contain all adjustments (consisting of normal recurring accruals) necessary to present fairly our financial position as of March 31, 2025, and our results of operations and cash flows for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Amounts for credit losses charged to expense, before recoveries, during each of the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024 were $69 and $73 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Pre-tax compensation expense (benefit) for equity-classified stock compensation awards recognized in Compensation and benefits in our statements of consolidated income for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024 was $21 and $(27) million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Marketable securities valued utilizing Level 1 inputs include active exchange-traded equity investments and equity index funds, and most U.S. government debt securities, as these securities all have quoted prices in active markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In connection with our plan for lower volumes from our largest customer, we began our Network Reconfiguration initiative, which is an expansion of Network of the Future.
